details.label: Discussion
details.text: Cells have intensified from central into southeast OH, south of the synoptic wind shift and within the instability axis. Precipitable water is high, with moderate instability developing. Midlevel northwesterlies of 30-40 kt are also supporting cellular and mixed storm modes including small bows. Given the destabilizing air mass downstream of the existing storms, gradual upscale growth may occur as outflow production/storm coverage increases

statements.summary: This afternoon and tonight. Showers and thunderstorms are expected again this afternoon.Some storms could be severe. Damaging wind is the primary threat, but large hail is also a possibility. Also, localized flooding is possible in areas that receive multiple thunderstorms.

details.label: Today's Hazards
details.text: This afternoon and tonight. Showers and thunderstorms are expected again this afternoon.Some storms could be severe. Damaging wind is the primary threat, but large hail is also a possibility. Also, localized flooding is possible in areas that receive multiple thunderstorms.

details.label: Extended Outlook
details.text: Saturday through Thursday. No hazardous weather is expected at this time.
